sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate faithfully encodes the direct-calculation requirement: applicability and ownership target the longitudinal frame, boundary-condition alternatives are mutually conditional with exact inclusive m = 13.3 or m < 13.3, all required operands and results use the declared datatypes and units, formulas use permitted arithmetic with tolerance scaled from expected results, section modulus uses CentiM3, and actual frame shear area is explicitly compared to gross frame shear area minus bracket area.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the boundary-condition property shape: frameBoundaryConditionType is an object property with range nltl:frameBoundaryConditionTypeValue, so remove sh:datatype and use the appropriate node/class constraint instead. Encode the true significantlyDifferentBoundaryConditions branch with the required comparison that frameMomentFactorM is smaller than 13.3; the current branch permits any factor, including 13.3 or a larger value. Ensure the shear-area result and formula semantics explicitly represent the required effective/actual frame shear area with bracket area excluded, rather than only asserting an unconstrained requiredShearArea result. Replace ABS-based tolerance expressions if unsupported by the DIRECT_CALCULATION evaluator with equivalent allowed arithmetic and simple piecewise comparisons; retain tolerance scaling from each expected result.

Repair the remaining semantic errors while preserving the prior boundary-condition and tolerance instructions. Use the canonical unit CentiM3 for sectionModulus by giving it a dedicated quantity shape; the current generic QuantityValueShape incorrectly requires CentiM2. Keep the requiredShearArea formula comparison to A_cm2, but do not also require actualFrameShearArea to equal A_cm2: actualFrameShearArea must be compared only to grossFrameShearArea - bracketArea, thereby encoding bracket exclusion. Encode the exact m = 13.3 false-boundary branch with equal inclusive numeric bounds (minInclusive and maxInclusive both 13.3), rather than the current inequality-based SPARQL test; retain the true branch requirement that m is strictly smaller than 13.3. Continue using tolerance scaled from each expected result, not the reported value, and retain the object/class constraint for frameBoundaryConditionType.

The candidate faithfully encodes the direct-calculation requirement: applicability and ownership target the longitudinal frame, boundary-condition alternatives are mutually conditional with exact inclusive m = 13.3 or m < 13.3, all required operands and results use the declared datatypes and units, formulas use permitted arithmetic with tolerance scaled from expected results, section modulus uses CentiM3, and actual frame shear area is explicitly compared to gross frame shear area minus bracket area.
